propositions: Plan-review attestations must track and pin the current narrow material fingerprint of direct children and prerequisites to prevent downstream agents from relying on stale assumptions after upstream plan changes
When pin enforcement is enabled, material drift in any pinned related ticket invalidates the downstream attestation; when disabled, drift is reported but does not invalidate

Ticket review phase (planning or execution) is maintained as a reducer projection in compiled state, updated only by winning process_status events, with execution-phase reviews enforcing a fixed 0.80 priority-floor threshold for blocking criteria
Close operation must verify a current certified plan review before proceeding when both require_plan_review_for_close and enforce_plan_material_pins are enabled, but must not require code freshness

Every direct prerequisite receives exactly one deterministic three-disposition coverage record (consistent, finding, or indeterminate) from a specialized criterion, with indeterminate cases preventing certification even when unreadable or evaluation fails

Pre-sign collection re-verifies all relationship membership and fingerprints under the store write lock; any concurrent relationship or fingerprint change aborts the review and triggers bounded retries
